title: Cates Park Paddling Centre
specs: Located in Whey Ah Wichen / Cates Park, ancestral land of Tsleil-Waututh First Nation
Paddlers under 19 must have parental consent form
1:1 adult to child ratio for children aged 5-15
2:1 adult to infant ratio for infants aged 1-4
Kayakers under 16 must be accompanied by adult in double kayak
Solo kayaking prohibited without solo capsize & recovery experience and proof
SUP solo paddling allowed age 12-15 with adult present; 16+ no supervision needed
Groups can book cultural walking, boat tours or paddle in traditional 35 ft ocean-going canoe via Takaya Tours
gap: Exact duration options for rentals not fully detailed
blurb: Cates Park Paddling Centre offers kayak and paddleboard rentals from May to September, located 5 minutes from Deep Cove. They operate by reservation and have weather-dependent hours. The centre partners with the Tsleil-Waututh First Nation to offer cultural tours.
extraNote: 24 hours notice required to cancel hourly rentals; $15 penalty if less · 48 hours notice required to cancel overnight rentals; $15 penalty if less · Overnight rentals require phone booking and additional logistics · Eastern side of Whey Ah Wichen / Cates Park, past the playground and concession stand. · May to September
